boxes.text: Find the exact word, and the fizz feels heard.

ONE TINY TRY FOR TODAY
say one exact feeling word out loud, or write it on the poster’s line.

WHAT SCIENCE SAYS
Teens’ clearer feeling names were linked with less later low mood; teaching this move is a BEST GUESS.

WHAT I CAN DO
When I notice ______,
I ______.
______
______
Backup: Long breath out

HOW TO REMEMBER IT
Find the exact word, and the fizz feels heard.
Two quick breaths in through the nose, one long breath out.

WHERE IT CAME FROM
Feeling-name research: Nook, Harvard, 2018.
Search: emotion differentiation teens
Nook Somerville
